topic: E-130J integration and schedule risk versus later acquisition execution state
public_statement: GAO reports an approximately one-year movement in the low-rate production decision as system-integration risks materialized and records disagreement with the program office over iterative-development and digital-thread alignment.
internal_content: The later PB2027 MSAR records IBR closure and AV1 configuration PDR completion, retains full-system PDR as future, and reports zero aircraft delivered at that observation state.
notes: The later MSAR does not by itself negate GAO earlier risk analysis, and GAO does not establish later milestone failure. Both are retained as dated perspectives on different propositions.
